task_description: Fully remove the ML ensemble and RL agent decision layer from the MT5 Python bridge and make the system simple and self-tuning from LOCAL backtests instead of pre-trained checkpoints. Direction stays momentum-based (as it already was); the ensemble-derived confidence gate is replaced with a rules-derived confidence (momentum magnitude, as backtest.py already computes). Delete the 12 neural/tree models, the RL agent, the RL-dependent smart-exit layer, the checkpoint training/retraining scripts, and the heavy sentiment/alt-data layers. Prune orphaned configs and heavy dependencies (torch, transformers). Lean on the existing AutoOptimizer for local-backtest self-tuning and verify it end-to-end. Keep the CSV signal contract unchanged (model_name='momentum') so the .mq5 EAs keep working. Update tests and docs.

review.post_review_polish: Both non-blocking v1 issues addressed in commit ea45529: (1) momentum-lookback window unified so backtest.py MOMENTUM_LOOKBACK derives from DataConfig().momentum_lookback (=8), making it the single source shared by the live generator, the backtester, and AutoOptimizer tuning; (2) the AutoOptimizer in-place config override lifecycle confirmed intentional and documented with a code comment (no snapshot/restore, consistent with the 'super simple' directive).

verification.summary: No compiled build (pure Python). OFFLINE sandbox: pandas/numpy/ta not installable, so DataFrame-dependent tests (test_backtester, test_signal_generator, test_bridge, test_multi_timeframe, test_news_calendar, test_smart_upgrades) cannot execute here and are verified by AST parse + no-deleted-import checks only. Executable verification: AST parse of all 29 python_bridge/**/*.py files OK; pure-Python suites test_auto_optimizer.py + test_dashboard.py pass 118/118 (includes 3 new local self-tuning tests proving parameter shift toward winning value, state persistence, and rollback on regression). Grep confirms zero references to models./EnsembleManager/RLAgent/PositionState/ExitAction/SmartExit/MODEL_DIR in retained code and tests (only a benign 'tracked models' docstring). models/, training/, smart_exits.py, train*.py, sentiment.py, alternative_data.py deleted. requirements.txt no longer lists torch/transformers. No Dockerfile present; docker build skipped. Test quality: the retained/added tests exercise the real AutoOptimizer self-tuning code path and would fail if that logic were reverted; DataFrame-path test quality could not be executed offline but was reviewed at source level.
verification.environment_note: Full 'pytest tests/ -v' cannot be green in this sandbox purely due to missing third-party libs (pandas/numpy/ta), not code defects. Code is written to run correctly in a real pandas/numpy environment.
